error.desc_404: There is nothing here — the address may be mistyped or the page may have moved.

debug_panel.title: Diagnostics
debug_panel.no_errors: No errors recorded in this session.

language.label: Preferred language
language.hint: The spool emails you in this language and opens in it after you sign in. Saving switches the interface to it straight away.

settings.title: Settings
settings.name: Name
settings.picture_hint: Your picture is the one your sign-in provider shares; without one the spool draws your identicon.

keys.intro: Your Ed25519 identity key. The hub keeps only the public key; the private key is created in this browser and never leaves it.
keys.use: The files use the spool CLI formats: the .key file works where a box key or a root key does, and the .pub file is a pin value. No spool feature requires this key yet.
keys.private_warning: Download the private key now. It exists only in this page: the hub never had it, so it cannot be downloaded again after you leave.
keys.upload_hint: Paste a spool public key (base64) or an ssh-ed25519 line, or choose a .pub file. It replaces your active key.
keys.uploaded: Public key uploaded — it is now your active key.
keys.regenerate_hint: Replaces your active key. Use it if you lost the private key.
keys.unsupported: This browser cannot create Ed25519 keys. Create a pair with the spool CLI (spool root-keygen --out FILE) and upload the public key it prints.

error.bad_public_key: That is not an Ed25519 public key.
error.private_key_refused: That is a private key — upload only the public key and keep the private key secret.
error.duplicate_key: That public key is registered already.
error.rate_limited: Too many key changes — try again later.
error.unauthenticated: Your session ended — sign in again.
error.network: The hub did not answer — try again.

error.invalid_state: That sign-in link expired — try again.
error.exchange_failed: The provider could not confirm you — try again.
error.email_unverified: Your account has no verified email with this provider — try another.
error.not_allowed: This account cannot sign in here.

native_error.email_unverified: Confirm your email first — we can send the link again.
native_error.not_allowed: This account has no access here yet — ask the owner for an invite.
native_error.verification_token_invalid: That link is not valid any more.
native_error.verification_token_expired: That link expired — we can send a new one.
native_error.reset_token_invalid: That reset link is not valid any more — ask for a new one.
native_error.email_delivery_unavailable: We cannot send email right now — try again later.
native_error.rate_limited: Too many attempts — try again later.
native_error.unauthenticated: Your session ended — sign in again.
native_error.network: The hub did not answer — try again.
native_error.retry_minute: Too many attempts — try again in a minute.
native_error.retry_minutes: Too many attempts — try again in {m} minutes.
native_error.password_too_short_min: That password is too short — use at least {min} characters.
native_error.check_form: Check the form and try again.

login.password_changed: Password changed — sign in with the new one.
login.session_unavailable: Session unavailable — the hub did not answer.

native.check_inbox: Check your inbox: we sent a link to confirm your email.
native.reset_sent: If that address has an account, a reset link is on its way.

verify.title: Confirm email
verify.ok: Your email is confirmed — sign in.
verify.missing: This link carries no token — open the link from the email again.
verify.expired_hint: Sign in again with your email and password to get a new link.

reset.title: New password
reset.ok: Your password is set — sign in with it.
reset.missing: This link carries no token — ask for a new reset link.

checkout.title: Get a spool
checkout.not_on_sale: Spools are not on sale right now.
checkout.unsupported: Checkout is not open on this page yet — try again later.
checkout.email: Email — where the claim link is sent
checkout.card_note: Pay by card. Your card details go to the payment provider only — never to this site.

success.waiting: Waiting for the payment to be confirmed…
success.claimed: This key was already collected — on this page or from the emailed link. The hub does not keep it.
success.expired: The claim window has closed — contact support to re-key the tenant.
success.none: This browser tab holds no checkout. Use the claim link from the email we sent.
success.failed: The payment was not completed. No spool was created.
success.cancelled: The payment was cancelled. No spool was created.

claim.claimed: This key was already collected — on the success page or from this link. The hub does not keep it.
claim.expired: This link has expired — contact support to re-key the tenant.

key.warning_once: This is the only time this key is shown. It is not emailed and the hub does not keep it.
key.warning_save: Save it as a file readable only by you (mode 0600) and point {var} at it.

error.bad_request: Check the email address and try again.
error.bad_tenant_id: That name is not allowed — use lower-case letters, digits and dashes.
error.tenant_taken: That name is taken — pick another one.
error.payment_unavailable: Checkout is unavailable right now — try again later.
error.not_paid: The payment is not confirmed yet.
error.claimed: This key was already collected — on the success page or from the emailed link.
error.claim_expired: The claim window has closed — contact support to re-key the tenant.
error.conflict: This tenant was re-keyed meanwhile — contact support.
error.bad_link: This link is incomplete — open the link from the email again.
error.not_fake_checkout: This checkout is not a test checkout.
error.no_token: This browser tab does not hold the claim for this checkout — open the success page in the tab you paid from.
error.timeout: The payment is still not confirmed — reload this page in a minute.
error.network: The hub did not answer — try again.
error.storage_blocked: This browser blocks session storage — allow it for this site and try again.
error.card_declined: The card was not accepted — check the details and try again.
error.card_failed: The card payment did not go through — try again, or use another card.
error.card_sdk: The card form did not load — check your connection or content blocker and reload.

host.preparing: Your address {host} is being prepared (usually 15–30 minutes). This page updates when it answers; keep your key safe meanwhile.

error.no_tenant: No tenant selected — open the viewer with {query}.
error.api_host: The hub URL is the API host; tenant reads need {host} ({env_var} with {tenant}).

create_error.channel_exists: That channel already exists (or the name is reserved).
create_error.bad_channel: Use lowercase letters, digits and dashes (max 64).
create_error.view_door: Sign in to create a channel.

sidebar.create_channel_description_hint: Optional. Shown in the channel header, up to 500 characters.

help.channels: Click a channel to open it. The menu on a row copies its link or marks it read. Drag a row to set the order; a new channel stays below the rows you arranged.
help.direct_messages: Click a person or a bot to open the conversation. The menu can block, mute, or pin them, and an admin can remove them. Drag a row to set the order; someone new stays below the rows you arranged.

composer.code_hint: Code block: Enter adds a line, type ``` or press Esc to close, Ctrl+Enter or Cmd+Enter sends
composer.send_failed: Not sent — the message did not reach the hub.
composer.send_failed_closed: Not sent — the connection dropped. Your text is still here.
composer.send_failed_timeout: Not sent — the hub did not answer in time. Your text is still here.
composer.send_failed_empty: Nothing to send — a mention on its own is not a message. Add some text, or attach a file.

feed.open_topic_hint: Press Enter to open this message's topic.

edit.label: Edit message
edit.hint: Enter saves · Shift+Enter adds a line · Esc cancels
edit.shortcut_hint: Press e to edit this message
edit.failed_not_author: Only the author can edit this message.
edit.failed_not_editable: This message was sent from a box and cannot be edited.
edit.failed_not_found: That message is no longer there.
edit.failed_too_large: Too long to save. Attach it as a file instead.

topic.title: Topic
topic.reply_placeholder: Reply — Enter for a new line · Ctrl+Enter or Cmd+Enter to send · /search to filter
topic.no_replies: No replies yet — write the first one.

view_token.need_member: This tenant's topics need a member sign-in.
view_token.need_member_or_token: This tenant's topics need a member sign-in or a view token.

pane.resize_hint: Drag to resize. Double-click to reset.

search.omnibox_label: Omnibox: message this page, or /search to search everything

search.title: Search
search.help_intro: Type /search in the bar at the top, then words, "phrases" and operators, as in Gmail. Examples:
search.bad_query: The query could not be read: {detail}
search.rate_limited: Too many searches. Try again in {s} s.
search.budget: The search took too long. Narrow the query.
search.placeholder_target: Message {target} — Enter for a new line · Ctrl+Enter or Cmd+Enter to send · /search to search everything
search.unreachable: The search service could not be reached. Try again shortly.
search.slash_shortcut: Press / to focus the omnibox. Escape returns to where you were.
